drawings.prompt: A cloakroom at a party, seen from the front and a little from the side of the guests. Behind a long wooden counter stands the clerk (an invented cheerful clerk: simple round face, dot eyes, short tousled hair, a pencil tucked behind one ear, a collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves under a bib apron), reaching up to slide one more item into a big wall of open square pigeonholes behind the counter. The wall has about 6 rows by 8 columns of pigeonholes; each filled pigeonhole holds exactly two things: a blank round name tag on a string loop hanging from a small hook, and a small cardboard parcel tied with string. The last few pigeonholes at the bottom right are still empty. In front of the counter, on the left, stands the party guest (an invented young person: simple round face, dot eyes, short messy hair, a plain loose sweater, a large blank round name tag hanging on the chest), holding up only a blank paper question card and looking at the wall. Landscape image 1536x1024; the wall and the counter fill about 90% of the width and about 80% of the height. The tags, parcels and card are blank. No text, no letters, no numbers, no symbols, no logos anywhere.
